youtube_title: The Old Joliet Prison: built by the men it held
body: The prisoners built the walls that held them. In 1858, convicts began building the Joliet Prison in Illinois, out of limestone quarried nearby. Leopold and Loeb, and Baby Face Nelson, all did time here. It closed in 2002, and you've seen it in The Blues Brothers. But a tour guide and some paranormal investigators say something is still inside. In 2018, a visitor's photo seemed to show a woman in white, floating in the prison yard. Today, the Joliet Area Historical Museum runs seasonal tours; check dates at jolietprison.org before you go. 👻 Comment your town, and it could be next! #Joliet #Illinois #OldJolietPrison #Haunted #History #LaPorteAfterDark
